page.note: Ground: the black album card every page sits on.

page-raised.note: A loose sheet: modals, menus, settings groups, the instance header. One tone step above the page, no border.

page-raised-2.note: Hover on a loose sheet or a secondary (slot) button.

slot.note: Recessed slot: inputs, tracks, empty sticker places, code wells.

ghost.note: The printed ghost silhouette inside an empty slot (icon outline, dashed die line).

ink.note: Text and icons on the page. Called white pen.

ink-soft.note: Secondary text: descriptions, meta, inactive tabs.

ink-faint.note: Placeholders, disabled labels, ghost slot names. Only at 13px and up.

vinyl.note: The white rim of every die-cut sticker and the face of white stickers.

vinyl-ink.note: Text printed on a white sticker or a paper clipping.

vinyl-ink-soft.note: Secondary text on white stickers and clippings.

paper.note: News clippings and the login nameplate. Slightly greyer than vinyl so stickers still read as stickers on it.

cover.note: The album cover: launcher rail, installer sidebar, updater, login backdrop. Derived from the accent, never hard-coded.

cover-tab.note: An inactive index tab sitting on the cover.

cover-ink-soft.note: Group labels and secondary text on the cover.

scrim.note: Behind a loose sheet (modal). Flat, no blur.

accent.note: Nore violet. User-themable at runtime (--nore-accent). The Graj sticker, active slot pill, focus ring, selected keyline, switch on, icons on white stickers.

accent-light.note: Links, accent text on the page, the phosphor of focus on dark.

accent-deep.note: Pressed accent, progress fill under the Graj label, accent fields that carry small white text (contrast 5.9:1).

accent-ink.note: Text on an accent sticker. Large text only (22px heavy and up, 3.9:1); small text on accent uses accent-deep fields.

dot-wait.note: Waiting, update available, beta, starting, pending invite.

dot-error.note: Error, stopped by crash, danger, offline server.

dot-info.note: Information, links to docs, new content to look at.

dot-nore.note: Nore itself: Nore Client loader, Nore Hub players.

label-forge.note: Forge and NeoForge label sticker fill (dark text).

label-version.note: Minecraft version label sticker (white sticker, dark text).

halloween-page.note: Lights out: the album in a dark room.

halloween-ink-soft.note: Raised for lights-out so secondary text keeps 4.5:1 where the dark is deepest.

halloween-phosphor.note: Glow-in-the-dark stickers. The only colour allowed to glow, and only during Halloween.

halloween-pumpkin.note: Pumpkin stickers, the event tab, Halloween countdown.

halloween-torch.note: The flashlight cone that follows the pointer.

halloween-bat.note: Bat and spider silhouettes (dark stickers with vinyl rim).

winter-frost.note: Frost creeping from page corners, snow confetti.

shadows.name: flat
shadows.purpose: Page, slots and stickers at rest. Stickers are glued down: no shadow.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: A sticker being peeled: hover, drag, the moment before it sticks.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Loose sheets: modals, menus, toasts, dropdowns.

motion.name: --nore-dur-tap
motion.purpose: Press feedback.

motion.name: --nore-dur-quick
motion.purpose: Hover, colour and state changes.

motion.name: --nore-dur-base
motion.purpose: Routine transitions, value swaps.

motion.name: --nore-dur-exit
motion.purpose: Anything leaving. Always shorter than it arrived.

motion.name: --nore-dur-peel
motion.purpose: A sticker peeling off (toggle off, remove, dismiss).

motion.name: --nore-dur-overlay
motion.purpose: Loose sheet arriving (modal, menu, toast).

motion.name: --nore-dur-page
motion.purpose: Page turn in the launcher and site sections.

motion.name: --nore-dur-stick
motion.purpose: A sticker slapping into its slot (spring settle time).

motion.name: --nore-dur-launch
motion.purpose: App launch storyboard, total.

motion.name: --nore-dur-reveal
motion.purpose: Event reveal (lights out, frost), total.

motion.name: --nore-dur-ambient
motion.purpose: Slow loops: flashlight sway, snow fall cycle, drift.

motion.name: --nore-ease-out
motion.purpose: Arrivals.

motion.name: --nore-ease-in
motion.purpose: Departures.

motion.name: --nore-ease-in-out
motion.purpose: Loops and position swaps.

motion.name: --nore-ease-peel
motion.purpose: Corner lift then release.

motion.name: --nore-ease-rub
motion.purpose: The rub-down highlight sweep after pressing.

motion.name: --nore-spring-stick
motion.purpose: Sticker slaps into a slot: about 11% overshoot, settles in ~420ms.

motion.name: --nore-spring-tab
motion.purpose: Active tab and segmented pill travelling to a slot: ~4% overshoot.

motion.name: --nore-spring-knob
motion.purpose: Switch knob (a dot sticker) re-sticking on the other side.

motion.name: --nore-spring-soft
motion.purpose: Large objects: the album cover opening, the event poster.

motion.name: --nore-stagger
motion.purpose: List and grid entrances: 45ms apart, never more than 8 steps, so nothing takes over ~360ms to arrive.

components.name: Graj sticker
components.description: The one violet hero per view: pill, accent fill, 4px vinyl rim, Dela GRAJ.

components.name: Sticker
components.description: Die-cut object with a vinyl rim, flat at rest, lifts with a peel corner on hover.

components.name: Ghost slot
components.description: Where a sticker goes when it is off or missing: slot fill, dashed die line, ghost silhouette.

components.name: Dot sticker
components.description: State: ready, wait, error, event, info, nore, off.

components.name: Index tab
components.description: Active tab is a piece of page pulled over the cover, joined with concave corners.

components.name: Clipping
components.description: Paper news card with one washi tape strip.

narrative.overview: Everything a player owns in Nore is a sticker in their album. Black card pages, die-cut stickers with a white vinyl rim, ghost slots for what is off or missing, dot stickers for state, an accent-dyed bookcloth cover. Source of truth: design/tokens.json.
keyCharacteristics: Black album card ground with fibre grain
Accent-dyed cover for rails, installer, updater, login
Stickers flat at rest; shadow only while peeled
Ghost slots for off and empty
Dela Gothic One display, Onest text, Minecraft font in game
rules: No glass, no glow outside Halloween phosphor
No tilt in game or in lists
